# What should you charge for an interpreting assignment?

> Turn an assignment request's hours, travel, and setting into a defensible interpreting fee, plus a late-cancellation fee calculator. Entirely client-side.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This calculator vs. a flat fee per assignment](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/sign-language-interpreter-rate-calculator/vs-a-flat-fee-per-assignment.html)
